instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct object pronoun.

hint.text:
An object pronoun can replace the object of a sentence.

For example:
Linh helps Patrick.
Linh helps him.
→ him = object pronoun

atoms.b: My cousin sent ((++me I)) a letter from Poland.
Can you help ((++her she)) with the surprise party?
Tilly asked ((++us we)) if we could look after her dog.
I will teach ((++them they)) how to build a snowman.
I gave ((++him he)) the last slice.
Is there a way I can persuade ((++you she)) to go to the cinema with me?
I saw ((++it they)) on TV yesterday.
